databases.name: ops
databases.retention: The ops plugin retains operational memory and redacted call history until its own explicit policy expires them; it never prunes corpus or cron.

databases.description: Durable operational memories and redacted CLI and MCP call history.
questions: What did agents write or hand off?
Which operational decisions, questions, reviews, or issues exist?
Which CLI or MCP calls ran or failed?

tables.name: memories
tables.description: Agent-written handoffs, coordination, and proposed knowledge with system-stamped authorship and explicit expiry.
questions: What did agents write or hand off?

tables.name: memories_fts
tables.description: Accent-insensitive full-text index over operational memory content.

tables.name: legacy_records
tables.description: Quarantined agent-coordination and query-teaching records retained without pretending they are active v1 surfaces.

tables.name: call_history
tables.description: Durable redacted CLI and MCP call history retained by ops independently of corpus and cron.
questions: Which CLI or MCP calls ran or failed?

tables.name: call_history_segments
tables.description: Checksummed retained JSONL segments already imported into durable call history.

tables.name: call_history_state
tables.description: The parity marker that gates switching doctor from JSONL to durable ops reads.

tables.name: plugin_schema
tables.description: The ops database schema and index versions; its migration lifecycle lives in plugin_migrations.

tables.name: plugin_migrations
tables.description: Lifecycle and verification outcome of every named custody migration this database hosts.

tables.name: migration_batches
tables.description: Fully committed, checksummed source batches imported into ops custody.

tables.name: custody_memberships
tables.description: Source identities represented by each physical row in ops custody.

tables.name: memory_records
tables.description: Canonical physical memory payloads prepared for the future federated route.

tables.name: memory_records_fts
tables.description: Derived accent-insensitive full-text shadow index over canonical memory payloads.

tables.name: memory_provenance
tables.description: Source-specific harvest provenance retained beside canonical physical payloads.

tables.name: memory_compatibility
tables.description: Shadow-only projection that reproduces every legacy database label and memory ID.

verbs.name: store
verbs.description: Write an operational memory with authorship and lifecycle metadata.

verbs.name: query
verbs.description: Answer a natural-language question over federated memory.

verbs.name: exec
verbs.description: Run a read-only SQL statement under the shared gate.

verbs.name: sql
verbs.description: Compile a natural-language question into read-only SQL without running it.
